review_basis.method: Direct visual inspection of each of the eight supplied candidate PNGs, with read-only inspection of their case metadata and the written handoff/prototype contract. No other PNGs were loaded.

evidence_identity.capture_state: Demo, offline library route with the library-filter choices sheet open.

Recent Read and descending direction remain black with white labels; the eight sorting choices form four aligned two-column rows, and neither the long sort labels nor the Completed exclusion label is clipped.

The full-width white bottom sheet has a clear top rule, a readable title and Done action, and visible bottom padding below the filter row. No dimmed backdrop, popup shadow or interface stipple is visible.
The exposed background preserves the library heading, white outlined continuation card and four-column cover strip. The recorded library folio is 1 of 5; its pager is covered by the sheet.

The other filters also remain neutral, while Recent Read and descending direction retain their separate inverse selection treatment.
The sheet retains the same readable two-column sort grid and full filter row, without overlap or cropped controls. Its white background leaves the visible library area undimmed.
The metadata records eight visible books and a restored 1-of-6 folio. The exposed first four covers and the common neutral PNG hash agree with the other supplied neutral return captures.
The state records library_filters [1, 0, 0, 0]. Downloaded is clearly included through a black fill, white checkmark and white label; the remaining filters stay white and unmarked.

The white continuation card and library tabs remain legible above the panel. The sheet uses the expected outlined, undimmed visual treatment without a shadow.

The exposed cover strip changes again. All eight visible-book records have downloaded=false, and the metadata records a 1-of-5 folio.
The enlarged exclusion label remains fully inside its control and does not collide with Unread. The sort grid, selected descending cell and Done action are aligned and readable.
The panel remains white with its black top rule; no scrim, popup shadow or patterned interface fill is visible. Patterned cover artwork belongs to the underlying fixture covers.
The state records library_filters [0, 0, 0, 0]. Downloaded returns to a neutral white control with no residual checkmark, X, strike or dashed border.
The exposed first cover row returns to the neutral book sequence. The metadata again records eight visible books with mixed downloaded flags and a 1-of-6 folio.
The neutral PNG hash is identical to the supplied Completed-neutral and Tracked-neutral captures, consistent with a shared cleared-filter appearance rather than a stale exclusion rendering.
The two-column sorting choices, inverse selected sort/direction cells, sheet title, Done action and four filters remain fully readable without visible clipping or overlap.

No linked-account claim or simulated authorization success is shown. The sheet obscures the main empty-result region, so the wording and placement of any empty-state message cannot be assessed from this capture.
The state records library_filters [0, 0, -1, 0]. Tracked is excluded with a visible X, dashed outline and strike, while Downloaded, Unread and Completed remain neutral.
The visible top-row cover strip returns after the empty included state. Metadata records eight visible library books and a 1-of-6 folio.
The Tracked exclusion label is fully contained; the next Completed control has a clear gap and stays inside the right sheet inset.

Recent Read and descending direction remain independently selected with inverse fill. The sheet and visible continuation card preserve white backgrounds and outlines, with no dimmed backdrop or popup shadow.
The state records library_filters [0, 0, 0, 0]. Tracked returns to a plain white neutral control, and no active inclusion or exclusion mark remains on any filter.
The restored neutral cover strip is visible above the sheet. Metadata records eight visible books and a 1-of-6 folio, matching the other supplied neutral returns.
The capture has the same SHA-256 as the Completed-neutral and Downloaded-neutral captures. Each file was nevertheless opened and visually inspected separately.

All eight sort choices, the direction pair, the title and Done action, and all four filter controls are readable and fit in the white edge-attached sheet with bottom padding. No visible clipping, shadow or interface stipple was found.

limitations: This review covers only the eight assigned PW5 candidate captures. The Completed include state and the Unread filter cycle are outside this batch.

No independent reference PNG was supplied or opened for any of these exact states. The assessment uses written scope, handoff and prototype declarations; it does not claim per-state pixel matching or a complete clean round.
The open sheet covers most library results, the main empty-result area, the pager and the dock. Their hidden geometry, empty-state text and resulting page contents cannot be visually certified here.

Existing metadata and checks were read as capture evidence. The review did not execute an application, a build, tests, validation suites or runtime probes, and does not independently prove action dispatch, persistence, outside-tap dismissal, full-control press timing or hardware refresh behavior.

Recorded run, source and binary identities match the assignment, and current PNG hashes match both the batch and case evidence. The source tree and executable themselves were not rehashed in this static review.

Static desktop PNGs do not qualify physical sleep/wake, hardware capabilities, e-ink waveforms or operation within a 512 MiB memory limit. Closed-reader artwork-only behavior, unavailable hardware rows, quality options and authorization screens are not present in this batch.
